# World TEBMA Martial Arts Federation

> The global governing body for traditional TEBMA martial arts — overseeing certification, competition, and technical standards across 140 member nations.

The federation preserves the technical integrity and philosophical foundations of TEBMA disciplines. It publishes official news, maintains a photo dictionary of standardized techniques, governs discipline curricula, issues verifiable practitioner certificates, and manages membership for schools and individuals worldwide.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Federation overview, latest news, and certificate verification.
- [News & Bulletins](/news): Official announcements, technical updates, and championship dispatches.
- [Disciplines & Styles](/styles): Formal martial arts disciplines governed by the federation.
- [Rules & Bylaws](/rules): Competition rules, ranking standards, and federation bylaws.
- [Photo Dictionary](/dictionary): Visual glossary of federation-standard techniques, stances, and etiquette.
- [Gallery](/gallery): Photographs from championships, seminars, and member schools.
- [Membership](/membership): Membership tiers and application information.
- [Certificate Verification](/verify): Verify the authenticity of a TEBMA-issued certificate by code or QR.
- [About](/about): History, mission, and governance of the federation.
- [Contact](/contact): Contact the federation secretariat.
